content:
I previously introduced CardPointers on 9to5Mac, highlighting how useful it is for helping everyone maximize credit card rewards and offers. Now CardPointers 8 is officially launched, featuring Siri AI integration, brand new widgets, and many new features.

The concept of CardPointers is simple: help you make the most of all your credit card rewards, including credit card offers, monthly spending thresholds, sign-up bonuses, and more. It can also help you keep track of details like annual fee renewal dates.

For long-time users, one of the biggest changes in CardPointers 8 is support for in-app offer syncing:

Link your accounts (it also supports multiple accounts from the same bank), and let CardPointers automatically activate all the offers on your Amex, Chase, Citi, Bank of America, US Bank, and Wells Fargo credit cards. CardPointers can now automatically sync offers every night while you sleep, so you'll never miss any offers again. And as the number of offers increases, it's even more important to help you find the most worthwhile ones, so now you can filter and sort by offer rating to find the offers with the highest rewards.

Other new features in CardPointers 8:

  • Siri AI integration: Added 36 new App Intents and on-screen awareness features to find, redeem, update, and share offers.
  • Visual Intelligence: Point your iPhone at a store, product, screenshot, or receipt, and CardPointers will tell you which card to use, along with related offers.
  • Eight new extra-large iPhone Home Screen widgets.
  • Track how much you've saved through the brand new "Offer Savings" dashboard.
  • Automate actions for regularly recurring standard offers.
  • Customize offers with AI and set up recurring executions.
  • Use AI to summarize offer terms and conditions.
  • Brand new Mac menu bar app.

9to5Mac readers can enjoy a 50% off discount on CardPointers, plus an extra US$200 gift card as a sign-up bonus. I've been using this app for a long time, and it's a great example of an application that respects the Apple platform and consistently keeps up with new platform features.
